name: molt
description: Context handoff as a Claude Code mod. Past a soft threshold of the context window (default 50%) the session is asked to finish its step and write a handoff; past a hard threshold (65%) only the handoff's own tools run. molt then runs /clear in the same pane and seeds the fresh session with the handoff, so no successor session is launched. Works in any terminal or orchestration layer. Requires Claude Code 2.1.289 or later.

softPercent.title: Soft threshold (% of the context window)
softPercent.description: Past this fill the session is asked, once, to finish its step and write a handoff.

hardPercent.title: Hard threshold (% of the context window)
hardPercent.description: Past this fill only Write, Edit, Skill, git add and git commit run until the session molts.

fallbackMargin.title: Fallback margin (points above hard)
fallbackMargin.description: With no handoff by hard + this margin, molt writes a fallback brief from the transcript and molts.

minRoomPercent.title: Room for a fresh session (points)
minRoomPercent.description: A seeded session does not reach its soft threshold until its fill is this many points above its starting fill.

manualMaxMolts.title: Molts in a row without a message (manual mode)
manualMaxMolts.description: In manual mode molt pauses after this many molts with no prompt from you.

instructionsTemplate.title: Handoff instruction file
instructionsTemplate.description: What the session is told at the soft threshold. Written with the default on first start; edit it freely.

seedTemplate.title: Seed file
seedTemplate.description: The one prompt the fresh session receives. {{path}} is the handoff. Written with the default on first start.
